architecture.overview: Repository with 11 files across 7 modules. 88 public exports, 16 types, 60 functions.

ai_summary.overview: TMS-Migrator is a database migration tool designed to transfer data between different database systems with parallel processing capabilities. It provides configurable batch processing, data validation through checksums, and filtering mechanisms for selective migration.
ai_summary.purpose: To facilitate reliable and efficient database migrations with support for parallel processing, data integrity validation, and customizable migration rules
key_features: Parallel data migration using worker pools
Configurable batch processing with customizable batch sizes
Data integrity validation through checksum verification
Migration filtering and selective data transfer
Lookup data management for reference integrity
ai_summary.architecture_style: Modular monolith with worker pool pattern
suggestions: Add comprehensive logging and monitoring capabilities
Implement resume functionality for interrupted migrations
Add support for more database types and connection pooling
Add performance profiling and optimization tools
